what_releases_unlock_RELEASED_status: Run: pip install ultralytics torch (with MPS or CUDA backend).
Run: python3 -m ml.fire_detection.eval.prep_datasets prep all (after manual dataset download).
Run training per runs/v0.1.0/train_recipe.yaml (~10 epochs MPS, or ~6 hours RTX 5070 Ti).
Run: python3 -m ml.fire_detection.eval.eval_harness --checkpoint runs/v0.1.0/weights/best.pt --dataset dfire --output runs/v0.1.0/eval.json
Re-run pytest; flip manifest.json status from TRAINING_READY to RELEASED.
